card.name: Limited data in overdosage sections
card.fires_on: The word data after "limited", and nearby words like available or concerning, in statements that little or no data exist on overdose. Seen mostly under the OVERDOSAGE heading.

modes.label: After limited
modes.description: The word data right after "Limited" or "limited" at the start of an overdose statement.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE There are limited<< data>> available on overdoses with ACTEMRA

modes.label: Rest of the phrase
modes.description: Words that finish the phrase, such as available, concerning, or the closing period.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE Limited data are<< available>> related to overdosage in humans.

card.plain: It fires on the standard label line saying little or no information exists about overdose in humans.
